name: Tradition A – Ashtakoota (36) + Rajju + Vedha
note: Nakshatra classification tables below are the widely published ones (source grade C). Scoring matrices marked 'verify' are NOT populated until checked against a named source.

vashya.provenance: Commonly published table; not verified against a named source (grade C/D). Rows = bride's group, columns = groom's group; asymmetric.

A.name: Vashya Profile A (primary teaching profile)
A.source: Supplied by the course author as the primary teaching matrix; attribution to a named text not verified

A0.name: Vashya Profile A0 (table used in earlier drafts of this course)
A0.source: Commonly published table recalled for earlier drafts; not verified against a named source

B.name: Vashya Profile B (fractional 1.5 variant)
B.note: Research found published tables that show 1.5 for some pairs (for example Chatushpada with Vanachara) but no complete, source-verified matrix was obtained. Requires further source verification.

C.name: Vashya Profile C (directional / alternative category interpretation)
C.note: Published implementations differ in category allocation and matrix conventions (for example the treatment of Aquarius). Requires further source verification.

vashya.halfSignRule: Sagittarius: first 15 deg = Manava, last 15 deg = Chatushpada. Capricorn: first 15 deg = Chatushpada, last 15 deg = Jalachara. Group is chosen from the Moon's degree within the sign.

yoniProvenance: Active matrix = Yoni Profile A (Maitreya-style reference matrix, supplied by the course author; attribution to Maitreya software or to any text is NOT verified; grade C/D). Rows = bride's Yoni, columns = groom's Yoni. Asymmetric in two pairs (Horse/Deer and Buffalo/Lion). 4 same, 3 friendly, 2 neutral, 1 unfriendly, 0 sworn enemy.

A.name: Yoni Profile A – Maitreya-style reference matrix (as supplied; attribution unverified)
A.source: Supplied by the course author as the primary teaching matrix; no verified textual or software source
A.orientation: row = bride's Yoni, column = groom's Yoni

A0.name: Yoni Profile A0 – symmetric table used in earlier drafts of this course
A0.source: Commonly published symmetric table recalled for earlier drafts; not verified against a named source
A0.orientation: row = bride's Yoni, column = groom's Yoni

B.name: Yoni Profile B – five-level simplified model
B.note: Categories (friendly, neutral, unfriendly) come from an explicit classification that is provisional until a researcher approves it; here derived from the symmetric A0 table.

C.name: Yoni Profile C – same / enemy / other model
C.note: Same = 4, sworn enemy = 0, every other combination = 2.

D.name: Yoni Profile D – sex-aware same-Yoni model
D.note: Same Yoni with complementary male/female Nakshatra designations = 4; identical designation = 3; other pairs as Profile A.

E.name: Yoni Profile E – custom regional profile (editable 14 × 14 matrix)
E.note: Editable copy of Profile A, stored on this device.

grahaMaitri.note: Scale is the commonly published one; verify against a named source before freezing.

gana.provenance: Active Gana profile is Profile A, supplied by the course author as the primary teaching matrix (attribution to a named text unverified; grade C/D). Variants exist.

rajju.rule: same Rajju group = Rajju Dosha (pass/fail, no points)

vedha.provenance: Commonly listed pairs; some manuals group Mrigashira, Chitra and Dhanishta differently (grade C).
vedha.rule: pair in Vedha list = Vedha Dosha (pass/fail, no points)
